config.notes: Pages read are mostly www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-programs/<degree>-<subject>.html (Graduate Programs pages): ADDITIONAL INFORMATION box gives Delivery Mode and Degree Level; "Length of Program" heading gives duration; English Language Requirement block gives IELTS overall where the department sets it (otherwise the central FGSR rule applies: IELTS 6.5 overall, 6.0 each band, https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/resources/policies-procedures/graduate-program-manual/section-5-admissions/5-8-english-language-proficiency-requirement.html). Neither graduate pages nor Faculty of Arts program guides print tuition amounts or start terms; undergraduate-programs pages render tuition only in the browser (Canadian/International toggle). No term_months set: the 2026-27 academic schedule page (calendar.ualberta.ca content.php?catoid=69&navoid=20862) is browser-rendered. International view check (5 Oct 13:02): undergraduate program pages (www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/<slug>.html) were read through Firecrawl (10 pages) and captured: the "Tuition and Fees" block only offers a "View costs for: Canadian High School / International Student" selector and a link to the cost calculator; no fee amount is printed in the rendered page and no URL variant for the international selection was found in stored evidence, so no page_view is kept. The Deadline block prints "Fall application Domestic: March 1, 2027 International: March 1, 2027" (Fall entry for international students). Undergraduate pages do not print delivery mode or an IELTS score (central rule applies). Their headings are the major only ("Chemistry"), so neither the reader nor this adapter confirms identity; courses rebound by hand are read by the general reader.
